tools.name: whats_new

tools.name: catch_up

tools.name: whats_happening

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: rebuild, furnish, provide, post, market, workshop, commons · Private data: feedback, card_poll, door_line, me, post, commons · Public sink: go, film_dance, postcard, post · Destructive: let_go, command.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: rebuild, furnish, provide, post, market, workshop, commons · Private data: feedback, card_poll, door_line, me, post, commons · Public sink: go, film_dance, postcard, post · Destructive: let_go, command

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
